versions.name: Cedar Point Scout Camp

features.note: Two heated lodges with full kitchens and fireplaces.
A shower house with six showers and six toilets.
An accessible toilet and shower in the shower house.
Fishing gear and a portable ice-fishing house can be rented.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp near Fairmont offering NOVA modules, a RAD Zoo, astronomy, ice cream making, and shooting sports.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/283-CubScoutResidentCamp); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
